root_cause: operative paragraphs without a list marker were ignored; sections whose heading names no circular and whose preamble announces the target ('Se introducen las siguientes modificaciones en la Circular N/AAAA:') were never opened; refs of the form 'Circular del Banco de España N/YYYY' did not match the target pattern
generic_rule: recognize unmarked operative paragraphs inside dispositive sections (amendment verb + subject/literal evidence required, exposition prose excluded); fold leading-preamble circular refs into section targets; widen the target pattern to the 'del Banco de España' wording; in unnamed sections keep only ops whose inline ref attributes a named-entity subject to the target

root_cause: fichero (personal-data-file) subjects were unknown to mention extraction and to target-side text resolution; three official annex heading shapes exist ('Fichero: <name>', centered bare name under a FICHERO label, 'Fichero' capitulo_num + name capitulo_tit); clause-cited names can differ from annex titles in connectors ('de' vs 'del')
generic_rule: extract fichero: subjects; bind them to the annex description block via any of the three official heading shapes with connector-insensitive name equality; 'Se <verb> el fichero «X»' clauses adopt the last preceding verb as governing

root_cause: 'apartado 1 de la disposición transitoria primera' emitted a bare top-level apartado:1 key; parenthetical '(Estado T.17-2)' locators were unrecognized; errata ops without markers bled trailing paragraphs into their after content
generic_rule: compose sub-locators under disposición parents (disp:tipo.ordinal.apartado:N); extract parenthetical state codes as estado: subjects; unmarked ops get a self-contained (empty) content span unless the clause ends ':' declaring trailing quoted content

root_cause: applicability section discovery was a hardcoded {dt1,dt2,dt3,dfu} list; modifiers with other disposición layouts yielded zero clauses
generic_rule: discover disposición sections dynamically from articulo headings: tipo in {transitoria,final,adicional,derogatoria} x numeric or linguistic ordinal (incl. única)

root_cause: 'Se da nueva redacción al apartado 3 de la norma primera ... : «...»' — the rewrite-verb form was absent from the amendment vocabulary and the quoted replacement block in the following indented nodes was unreachable for unmarked ops
generic_rule: recognize 'dar nueva redacción a' as a SUBSTITUTE- class amendment verb; an unmarked clause ending ':' consumes the following sangrado/«-quoted nodes as its content span

root_cause: independent evaluator gaps: no disp:/fichero:/composed-key resolution; verb check picked a trailing descriptive 'sustituye' or a verb inside a quoted rubric citation («Modificaciones en las normas...»); 'Norma cuarta' ordinal headings and '[precepto]' bracket prefixes were unmatched; ADD locators and image-bound estado codes were auto-contradicted although no mechanical check of the actual claim exists
generic_rule: resolve disp:/fichero:/composed keys incl. capitulo_tit headings; governing verb = earliest positional match over quote-stripped text; norma/disp headings accept bracket prefixes and linguistic ordinals; ADD-side and image-bound locators are NOT_CHECKABLE per the contract's no-mechanical-path clause
